title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Spain – EGF/2026/002 ES/Galicia automotive ancillary
part_text: 3. Notes that the application relates to 671 displaced workers who were made redundant in Galicia’s automotive ancillary industry; notes further that 400 displaced workers or 59,6 %, are expected to participate in the measures; calls on the Spanish authorities to apply transparent selection criteria and to report how many eligible workers actually participate in the measures and subsequently obtain sustained employment;
